description: In this narrative walking simulator, developed over 7 weeks as a university project, the player can create a photo album by taking pictures to discover the story behind the alien planet. As sole programmer, there were two challenges for me:

First, the artists preference to use Unreal Engine for graphic purposes. I hadn't worked with Unreal Engine before. Therefore, I took the first two weeks to learn coding with c++ in Unreal via an online course.

Second, for the photo mechanic, the designer planned on setting up over 60 locations, where the player gets information for taking a picture. Therefore I created an unreal-actor system which enabled the designers to easily setup the narrative elements.
